comparisons.comparison: Both JPMorgan and Bank of America disclose their reportable business segment structures for fiscal year 2024, but they differ in the number of segments and recent structural changes. JPMorgan reported three reportable segments (CCB, CIB, AWM) after a reorganization in Q2 2024 that combined its Corporate & Investment Bank and Commercial Banking units. In contrast, Bank of America maintained four business segments (Consumer Banking, GWIM, Global Banking, Global Markets) without mentioning a comparable consolidation, indicating a stable four-segment structure versus JPMorgan's streamlined three-segment model.

sentences.text: Effective in the second quarter of 2024, JPMorganChase reorganized its reportable business segments by combining the former Corporate & Investment Bank and Commercial Banking business segments to form one reportable segment, the Commercial & Investment Bank.

As a result of the reorganization, the Firm has three reportable business segments - Consumer & Community Banking ("CCB"), Commercial & Investment Bank ("CIB") and Asset & Wealth Management ("AWM") - with the remaining activities in Corporate.

Through our various bank and nonbank subsidiaries throughout the U.S. and in international markets, we provide a diversified range of banking and nonbank financial services and products through four business segments: Consumer Banking, Global Wealth & Investment Management (GWIM), Global Banking and Global Markets, with the remaining operations recorded in All Other.

comparisons.peer_summary: Citigroup is managed via five operating segments (Services, Markets, Banking, Wealth, U.S. Personal Banking) with unassigned activities in All Other; International is further organized into six clusters for additional financial information, though not managed by the CODM.
comparisons.comparison: Both JPMorgan and Citigroup disclose their reportable business segment structures for fiscal year 2024, highlighting a difference in the granularity and count of segments. JPMorgan operates with three reportable segments (CCB, CIB, AWM) plus Corporate, having recently consolidated two prior segments. Citigroup is managed pursuant to five operating segments (Services, Markets, Banking, Wealth, U.S. Personal Banking) with unassigned activities in All Other. This reflects Citigroup's broader five-segment reporting framework compared to JPMorgan's three-segment structure.
